1479-3147-8337.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3259-4359-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-4359-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3781-4215-6495--124.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3781-4215-6495--124.notes:
Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1322-2411-3259.description:

Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-6972-7510.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

413-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
413-4559-7306-7430.description:

When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-4488-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4488-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

5256-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-6701--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

394-413-856-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
394-413-856-4321.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

813-3542-6485.description:

Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Scholar of the Ages and Palinchron, targeting Scholar of the Ages
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Scholar of the Ages and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Hogaak.
